kjv: so will we (Israel) render the calves of our lips (KJV 14:2)
mine: we (Israel) will offer the bulls of our lips
note: parim sefatenu "bulls (of) our lips" is usually read (with LXX, Heb 13:15) as "fruit (peri) of our lips", i.e. praise in place of sacrifice; both versions keep the MT image, but KJV's "calves" is a misleading animal.
